    "me" = 3, "mi" = 4,
    "fa" = 5, "fi" = 6,
    "se" = 6, "so" = 7, "sol" = 7, "si" = 8,
    "le" = 8, "la" = 9, "li" = 10,
    "te" = 10, "ti" = 11
  )
}
